about.title: About
about.heading: About Palimpsest
about.intro: Palimpsest is a Chinese novel reading platform. Browse and search the library, find books by category and ranking, read in a reader with adjustable fonts, spacing and themes, and keep your bookshelf, reading progress and bookmarks in sync between the web and the app.

features.conversion: Instant Traditional/Simplified Chinese conversion, plus English translation (when the translation service is enabled)
features.offline: Offline reading: chapters you've read are kept on your device, so you can keep reading without a connection; progress and bookmarks sync when you're back online
features.community: Reviews, chapter comments and likes to share your thoughts with other readers

about.seeLegal: Please read the {terms} and {privacy} before using the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This page is a draft based on the data the system currently collects and processes. It must be reviewed by legal counsel and completed with the operator's details and contact information before launch.

account.label: Account data:
account.text: your username, email address, nickname, bio, avatar and a hashed password (we can't see your actual password).

reading.label: Reading data:
reading.text: your bookshelf, reading progress, reading history and time, bookmarks and reading settings, used for syncing across devices and reading statistics.

community.label: Community content:
community.text: the reviews, comments, likes and reports you post. Reviews and comments publicly show your username, nickname and avatar, but never your email address.

technical.label: Technical data:
technical.text: to enforce rate limits, the system briefly records request counts per IP address and account (they expire after about a minute). Server logs may contain IP addresses and request paths.

device.title: Data stored on your device
device.text: The website uses cookies to keep you signed in and remember your interface language, and stores chapters you've read, your progress and bookmarks in the browser (IndexedDB) for offline reading. It also uses a service worker to cache the app's files and public pages so they open offline. The app stores this data in a local database on your device. Signing out deletes the local data that belongs to your account.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.text: When you use English translation, the chapter or selected text is sent to Google Cloud Translation. When you reset your password, we send the reset link through an email service.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can change your profile and reading settings and delete your bookmarks, reviews and comments at any time in Settings. To delete your account or get a copy of your data, please contact us.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draftNotice: This page is a draft. It must be reviewed by legal counsel and completed with the operator's details, contact information and governing law before launch.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Please provide a valid email address when you sign up and keep your password safe. Anything done through your account is considered your own action.

userContent.title: User content
userContent.text: You are responsible for what you post in reviews and comments. Do not post illegal, harassing or hateful content, spam, or anything that infringes the rights of others (including copyright), and please mark spoilers.
userContent.moderation: Other readers can report content. Moderators may hide or delete content, or suspend accounts that break these terms.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.text: Works on the platform belong to their authors or rights holders and are for personal reading only. Do not copy or distribute them without permission. Chapters downloaded for offline reading can only be read within this service.

translation.title: Translation
translation.text: Traditional/Simplified conversion and machine translation are provided for reference only and may differ from the original text.

limits.title: Usage limits
limits.text: To keep the service stable, the number of requests per minute is limited. Please don't use automated tools to scrape content.

stats.title: Reading stats
stats.legend: Bar height shows words read; the number above shows chapters read.
